node.statement: Dependency bridge: require nodes 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, and 1.5 to be validated. Then 1.1 supplies universal positive/finite constants e_it, K_disp, K_floor and the legal correction setup. In the exhaustive case epsilon>0, 1.2 supplies a finite dagger-preserving amplified output that is an extended K_floor*epsilon-inclusion, while 1.3 supplies its displacement bound sup_n ||v_{N,n}-v_n|| <= K_disp*d. In the case epsilon=0, 1.4 supplies the operator-norm limit, its amplification identity, and displacement bound, while 1.5 supplies dagger preservation and the extended 0=K_floor*epsilon-inclusion property. Hence, only after all five dependencies are validated, these conclusions jointly imply every clause of the root contract.
